lines.text: GTA 6's first patch fixed seven bugs. So did it fix the money glitch?
Update 1.002.002 landed four days after launch. It fixes crashes, stuck weather, autosaves, phone calls, the wanted level, a gym bar, and partners keeping loot bags.
Not one of them mentions the infinite money glitch!
Rockstar patched the money glitch. Myth! Outlets report it still works.
Guides warn a later update could close it without warning.
So should Rockstar patch it, or leave it alone? Comment which!
